# Stored version 1 capsules, and the real time-signal rounds that go with them (ST-072).
# Every later opener must open every capsule here. Each test reads this file.
#
# Every key and secret here is made up for tests. They come from the seeded test source
# of keeper/src/fakes.rs (seed 200: the secret, then two keys) and none of them is real.
# A key is written as its 32 bytes in hex; the tests turn it into the Recovery Key text
# (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...) with the opener's own encoder.
#
# The capsule bytes were not made by the keeper: they were put together from the output
# of the independent implementation on the noble libraries (keeper/src/capsule.rs), and the
# keeper's seal makes the same bytes from the same draws (keeper/src/opener.rs tests).
#
# Format: one "name value" pair a line. A capsule runs from "capsule" to "end".

capsule one-key-round-1000
generation 3
target 1000
sealed-with seed 7
key d177328d85568c0e3d16d888c35f1d32f3a157bbfd2f400f73908051d9d73b84
other-key 9d926f3020da0444b14bf118ecec08675886f195690e27dbc1d1f1b63a9b8d9b
secret muEdikQxRn6XM6oEXNLnNkPLpCvkNnjLLWuQPsCp
sha256 f8bb67d757a4f12daa236c6c4b6b2d8f6f087524299e9533a40175c9bb03ba9c
base64 
end
